headline: GDPR and UK GDPR readiness.
subheadline: We support controllers (schools) with technical and organizational measures: access control, export, retention tooling, and breach notification workflows.

segments.title: Roles
segments.body: Your school is typically the controller; RunMyCampus processes data on documented instructions (processor).

segments.title: Rights
segments.body: Export, rectification, and erasure flows are exposed per tenant admin workflows; DSAR coordination via your DPO contact.

segments.title: Transfers
